metadata.question: Did the regions around Mount Isa and Townsville in Queensland experience over 65 centimeters of rainfall between January 27 to February 10, 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search Strategy**: - Need to find rainfall data for two locations: Mount Isa and Townsville, Queensland, Australia - Date range: January 27 to February 10, 2019 - Need to check if rainfall exceeded 65 cm during this period - Available datasets: TRMM (Tropical Rainfall Measuring Mission) or GPM (Global Precipitation Measurement) are standard for rainfall analysis in GEE - GPM IMERG is more recent; TRMM is legacy but may cover 2019 2. **Masking Strategy**: - Rainfall data doesn't require cloud masking in the traditional sense - Need to aggregate daily rainfall over the date range - Should sum all daily precipitation values between Jan 27 - Feb 10, 2019 - Check for data availability first 3. **Logic to Distinguish Valid Zero from Null**: - Valid rainfall of 0 cm means no rain → Answer B (did NOT experience over 65 cm) - Valid rainfall > 65 cm → Answer A (YES, experienced over 65 cm) - If no images found in the date range → C1 - If valid pixels = 0 after processing → C2 - If calculation returns NaN/None → C3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define locations const mountIsa = ee.Geometry.Point([139.4917, -20.7274]); // Mount Isa, QLD const townsville = ee.Geometry.Point([146.7781, -19.2643]); // Townsville, QLD // Define date range const startDate = '2019-01-27'; const endDate = '2019-02-10'; // Load GPM IMERG rainfall data const rainfall = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_V06') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('precipitationCal'); // precipitation in mm const imgCount = rainfall.size().getInfo(); console.log(`GPM Images found: ${imgCount}`); if (imgCount === 0) { console.log('No GPM data found. Trying TRMM...'); // Fallback to TRMM const trmm = ee.ImageCollection('TRMM/3B42') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('precipitation'); const trmmCount = trmm.size().getInfo(); console.log(`TRMM Images found: ${trmmCount}`); if (trmmCount === 0) { console.log('No rainfall data for Jan 27 - Feb 10, 2019'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Use TRMM (already in mm) const totalRainfallTRMM_Isa = trmm.reduce(ee.Reducer.sum()) .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: mountIsa, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }) .get('precipitation') .getInfo(); const totalRainfallTRMM_Towns = trmm.reduce(ee.Reducer.sum()) .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: townsville, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }) .get('precipitation') .getInfo(); const isaRainfallCm = totalRainfallTRMM_Isa / 10; const townsRainfallCm = totalRainfallTRMM_Towns / 10; console.log(`Mount Isa total rainfall: ${isaRainfallCm.toFixed(2)} cm`); console.log(`Townsville total rainfall: ${townsRainfallCm.toFixed(2)} cm`); if (totalRainfallTRMM_Isa === null || totalRainfallTRMM_Towns === null) { console.log('C3'); return; } if (isaRainfallCm > 65 && townsRainfallCm > 65) { console.log('Both regions exceeded 65 cm'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('At least one region did not exceed 65 cm'); console.log('B'); } return; } // Process GPM data (convert mm to cm) const totalRainfall_Isa = rainfall.reduce(ee.Reducer.sum()) .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: mountIsa, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }) .get('precipitationCal') .getInfo(); const totalRainfall_Towns = rainfall.reduce(ee.Reducer.sum()) .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: townsville, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }) .get('precipitationCal') .getInfo(); // Convert mm to cm const isaRainfallCm = totalRainfall_Isa / 10; const townsRainfallCm = totalRainfall_Towns / 10; console.log(`Mount Isa total rainfall: ${isaRainfallCm.toFixed(2)} cm`); console.log(`Townsville total rainfall: ${townsRainfallCm.toFixed(2)} cm`); if (totalRainfall_Isa === null || totalRainfall_Towns === null || isNaN(isaRainfallCm) || isNaN(townsRainfallCm)) { console.log('C3'); return; } if (isaRainfallCm > 65 && townsRainfallCm > 65) { console.log('Both regions exceeded 65 cm rainfall'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('At least one region did not exceed 65 cm'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
